knownBoundaries.scope: Original `trials` preserve graph truth verdicts but do not store full historical graph position/style. Adapter only claims explicit current endpoints and individual recorded probe verdicts; do not assert unrecorded historical graph movement.

conclusions.rules: Never turn existing CI PASS into final A; no mass second test round. Specific mathematical dispute -> targeted review/test; integration creates a changed HEAD -> run required exact-head CI and later post-merge main gates.
